key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as traders positioned for a potential RBA rate hike, with ARM rates surging ahead of the jobs report
Aussie banks forecast the biggest house price falls on record; CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since the federal budget
Iron ore sector faces a structural shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict; Macarthur clears WA bulk test hurdle
Bathla's collapse signals broader construction sector fragility; ratings agencies flag Victoria's soaring debt
ASIC launches whistleblower review at Big Four accounting firms, raising governance concerns
ASX small-caps active: Kaoko Metals, Vanadium Resources, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals in focus
EV sales overtake petrol cars in Australia for first time, but hidden costs and energy transition cost overruns noted
Australia's per-capita economy stalls while Canada's soars; RBA urged to pause before further hikes

sectors.trend: Bearish. CBA flags 15% drop in home loan applications post-budget; banks project record house price declines. Westpac and CBA face scrutiny over pricing loopholes for loyal customers. ASIC whistleblower review adds governance overhang.
sectors.implications: Pressure on NIMs and credit growth for CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX. Housing downturn risks loan-loss provisions. Regulatory scrutiny may cap fee income.

sectors.trend: Mixed. Iron ore faces a structural shakeout obscured by war-driven demand. Macarthur clears WA bulk test (positive for FMG.AX pipeline). Gold producers (Aurum) add high-grade ounces. Small-cap miners (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) see elevated retail activity.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX and RIO.AX exposed to iron ore price volatility. FMG.AX benefits from Macarthur progress. Gold names (GOLD.AX, REG.AX) supported by safe-haven flows. Small-caps carry high risk/reward.

sectors.trend: Volatile. TMK Energy gas rates surge ahead of Mongolian drilling. Beetaloo gas cartel concerns. Energy transition costs mounting as projects run off rails. Norway's $80B Treasury sale may pressure global yields.
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WES.AX, BGL.AX face transition-cost headwinds. Gas names (TMK, BGL) see near-term upside. Watch AUD sensitivity to LNG pricing.

sectors.trend: Bearish. Bathla's collapse is a systemic warning; housing construction expected to follow falling prices. Victoria's debt flagged by ratings agencies. Melbourne councils admit infrastructure cannot cope with planned population growth.
sectors.implications: CGP.AX, WBC.AX (construction exposure), and property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) face demand softening. Rate-sensitive REITs pressured by ARM surge.

sectors.trend: Mixed. EV adoption accelerates but hidden costs deter. Lululemon -17% on guidance cut signals global consumer softness. AI worker shortage in Australia supports tech hiring but Nvidia-led AI boom continues globally.
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX face consumer caution. CSL.AX, SGH.AX (healthcare) relatively insulated. Domestic tech/AI talent scarcity supports long-term productivity but near-term wage pressure.

key_themes: RBA rate-hike risk: ARM rates surging; market bracing for higher policy rate despite weak growth
Housing correction: Record house price falls forecast; 15% drop in loan applications; construction follows prices down
Iron ore structural shakeout: Geopolitical conflict masks supply/demand rebalancing
Construction sector fragility: Bathla collapse as bellwether; Victoria debt concerns
Regulatory scrutiny: ASIC whistleblower review at Big Four; bank pricing loopholes exposed
Commodity small-caps active: Gold, vanadium, rare-earth names drawing retail flows
EV transition: First-time EV sales lead but cost barriers and grid strain persist
Growth divergence: Australia's per-capita economy stalls vs Canada's surge

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike despite weak growth
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge rate-sensitive REITs and construction exposure; favour fixed-rate income; monitor ARM index closely

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and credit contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce bank and property REIT weightings; favour defensive financials with diversified income (CSL.AX, SGH.AX)
Diversify materials exposure beyond iron ore; favour gold and critical-mines names; monitor BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX earnings guidance
Avoid high-leverage construction and property developers; watch for further insolvencies in mid-tier builders
Monitor ASIC outcomes; assess CBA.AX, WBC.AX fee-income sustainability; favour banks with cleaner governance profiles
Prefer cash-generative energy majors over project-stage renewables; watch WES.AX, BGL.AX capex discipline

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical-mines small-caps on safe-haven and supply-chain flows
opportunities.rationale: Aurum adding high-grade ounces; Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals showing strong retail momentum; iron ore shakeout shifts capital to alternative metals

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare and consumer staples on housing correction
opportunities.rationale: CSL.AX and SGH.AX insulated from rate and housing cycles; WES.AX benefits from value-seeking consumers amid EV cost concerns

opportunities.recommendation: Selective gas exposure on TMK rate surge and Beetaloo cartel dynamics
opportunities.rationale: TMK Energy gas rates spiking ahead of Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo gas cartel concerns create pricing upside for domestic gas producers

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to banks and property REITs ahead of rate decision
defensive_moves.rationale: Record house price falls forecast; 15% loan application drop; ARM surge; ASIC scrutiny on Big Four and bank fee practices

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim construction and rate-sensitive REIT positions
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse signals sector-wide fragility; housing construction to follow prices lower; Victoria debt flagged by ratings agencies

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge iron ore concentration risk in materials portfolio
defensive_moves.rationale: Structural iron ore shakeout masked by geopolitical conflict; Macarthur progress is positive but sector-wide oversupply risk persists

market_outlook.short_term: Cautious-to-negative. ASX closed the week lower on rate-hike fears. ARM surge and 15% loan application drop signal credit tightening. Bathla fallout and ASIC review add overhang. Small-cap miners and gold provide relative outperformance. Expect volatility into RBA decision and US jobs report.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but uneven. 'Bull case returns' narrative persists, but Australia's per-capita growth stall vs Canada is a structural concern. Housing correction will be pro-cyclical for banks but supportive of defensive equities. Iron ore shakeout creates winners/losers within materials. Energy transition cost overruns delay but do not eliminate the secular trend.
